messages:
Maya Kaur: Nightly billing import failed — NetSuite batch import rejected due to line_description > 200 chars. This kicked off retries and we now have 3 duplicate draft invoices showing in Stripe. Putting the relevant logs/payload below, need a quick mitigation and then a cleanup plan.

billing-runner-bot: [alert] billing-import-nightly job 1758604321 FAILED: NetSuiteImportError: LINE_DESC_TOO_LONG -> batch_id=ns-batch-20251108-03

James Patel: Can you paste one of the offending invoice payloads (stripe invoice id + payload) so I can check what field is blowing up the import mapping?

Maya Kaur: sample payload (trimmed):
```json
{
  "stripe_invoice_id": "in_3Kxyz...",
  "customer": "cus_J7a2...",
  "lines": [
    {
      "amount": 150000,
      "description": "Plan: Pro — includes advanced analytics, 1000-seat override, metadata: {\"deployment_notes\":\"deployment-id=prod-abc123;trace=long-stack-trace:... (truncated)\"}",
      "quantity": 1
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {"usage_window":"2025-11-07T00:00Z/2025-11-07T23:59Z"}
}
```

Sam R.: I took a look — recent change in the usage-report job (commit b4f9c3e) started appending an 800+ char plan metadata blob into the invoice line description (we included full deploy notes + stack traces). NetSuite mapping expects line_description <= 200 chars, so the import API rejects the row and our idempotency logic requeues the batch, causing Stripe drafts to re-create.

Eli Torres: Short-term mitigation: truncate line descriptions before writing to Stripe / NetSuite CSV. Patch suggestion: in transform step do:
```py
# truncate line desc to NetSuite-friendly length
line[\"description\"] = line[\"description\"][0:180] + \"...\" if len(line[\"description\"]) > 183 else line[\"description\"]
```
Deploy that asap to stop retries. Longer-term we should move metadata into invoice.metadata not description.

Maya Kaur: I can deploy a hotfix to the transform in staging now and run the nightly import there to validate. If green, will push to prod in the 30-min emergency window. Also planning a manual dedupe pass for the 3 duplicate drafts in Stripe and mark the extras as void in NetSuite.

Ana Gomez: Please open a ticket and tag accounting (cc @Accounting). We need an estimate of revenue affected and a reconciliation plan before EOD. Also include who approved the hotfix.

Maya Kaur: Created ticket FIN-2025-489 in our tracker and pinged accounting. Estimated impact: 3 duplicate draft invoices totaling $3,500 USD — revenue recognition timing unaffected but messy for monthly AR report. Cleanup plan in ticket: 1) stop retries (hotfix), 2) run one-shot NetSuite import for batch ns-batch-20251108-03, 3) void duplicate Stripe drafts, 4) post a reversing journal in NetSuite for any duplicates that were accidentally posted.

James Patel: Once hotfix is deployed, can you post the deploy link and the job run-id so I can confirm reimport succeeded?

Maya Kaur: Will post updates here. Staging patch applied at 1758604500, staging import succeeded. Pushing to prod now (deploy link: https://deploys.redwood/prod/12345).

billing-runner-bot: [info] billing-import-nightly job 1758604660 STARTED

Maya Kaur: Prod import finished at 1758604668, status=SUCCESS. No new duplicates created. Manual cleanup: marked 3 Stripe drafts as void, created journal entry JE-2025-110 for reversing duplicates. Accounting confirmed reconciliation path.

Ana Gomez: Thanks — please follow up in FIN-2025-489 with postmortem on why metadata ended up in description and what change will prevent recurrence (owner: eng-ml + payments).
